_about: Recall fixtures for tools/memory/embed_bench.py and recall tests. Each query lists the memory ids that answer it. Queries are worded differently from the memories on purpose (paraphrase, follow-up style, spoken phrasing); several memories are near-miss distractors on the same topic. Synthetic household, written 2026-11-01.

memories.text: Adam asked what MOND is; Jarvis explained Modified Newtonian Dynamics, Milgrom's alternative to dark matter that changes gravity at very low accelerations.
Adam thinks dark matter is more likely than MOND because of the Bullet Cluster observations.
Adam asked how string theory compares with loop quantum gravity.
Adam is running a Dungeons and Dragons campaign called The Ashen Crown for four friends on alternate Saturdays.
In the Ashen Crown campaign the party is currently trapped in the dwarven city of Khazbar under the mountain.
Adam wants a map of a three-level dungeon beneath a ruined lighthouse for the next D&D session.
Ryan's favourite animal is the king cobra, and he asked for a picture of one wrapped around a tree.
Ryan asked whether dragons could really breathe fire and Jarvis talked about bombardier beetles.
Adam is vegetarian since September and does not eat fish either.
Adam dislikes cilantro; it tastes like soap to him.
The family's favourite takeout is the Thai place on Main Street, usually pad see ew and green curry.
Adam's mother's birthday is March 14th and she likes orchids.
Ryan's birthday party is planned for June 8th with a reptile show.
The left garage door opener has a weak battery in its tilt sensor.
Adam wants a warning if the garage is left open after 10 pm.
The car is due for an oil change at 45,000 miles; it is at 43,200 now.
The car's rear tyres were replaced in August with Michelin CrossClimate tyres.
Adam is building a local voice assistant called Jarvis on a Radeon RX 7900 XT.
Adam wants Jarvis to have an animated avatar with a face that lip-syncs and dims when idle.
Adam asked about the Business Source License and when it converts to Apache 2.0.
Adam's flight to Denver for a work conference leaves on November 18th.
Adam prefers aisle seats on flights.
The dentist appointment for the kids is on December 2nd at 3:30.
Adam is reading The Three-Body Problem and is halfway through the second book.
Adam did not like the ending of the Dark Forest; he thought the deterrence idea was clever but bleak.
Adam asked for a recipe for vegetarian chili with black beans and smoked paprika.
The basement dehumidifier needs its filter cleaned every month.
The Wi-Fi password was changed in October; the router is in the office closet.
Adam is learning to play the piano and practises Chopin's Prelude in E minor.
Adam thinks the Fermi paradox is best explained by the rarity of complex life.
Adam asked how long it takes light from the Sun to reach Earth: about eight minutes and twenty seconds.
The tomato plants on the deck got blight in July; Adam plans to rotate the garden beds next year.
Adam likes his coffee black, a medium roast from Ethiopia.
Adam sleeps poorly when the bedroom is warmer than 68 degrees.
The dog, Biscuit, needs her heartworm pill on the first of every month.
Biscuit is afraid of thunderstorms and hides under the stairs.
Adam considered switching the voice model to Qwen but kept Llama 3.1 because its answers sounded more natural.
Adam wants long-term memory for Jarvis stored in PostgreSQL with topics and a JSON detail field.
Ryan is learning multiplication tables and struggles with sevens and eights.
Ryan wants to be a herpetologist when he grows up.
Adam is training for a half marathon in April and runs on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Sundays.
Adam's left knee hurts on long downhill runs.
The family is planning a summer trip to Yellowstone and wants to see Old Faithful.
Adam asked whether the supervolcano under Yellowstone is likely to erupt soon; the answer was no.
Adam's favourite band is Radiohead, especially the album In Rainbows.
Adam asked Jarvis to stop playing music in the den after 9 pm on school nights.
The smoke detector in the upstairs hallway chirped; its battery was replaced on October 20th.
Adam asked about the difference between a crocodile and an alligator for Ryan.
Adam is considering solar panels and asked about payback time in Ohio.
Adam thinks consciousness may be an emergent property and enjoys debating it.
